elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance “for a period of up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided “at HDI's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required within 30 days of the defined “Termination Date,” which is established for termination by notice, not within 30 days after expiration. The timing therefore does not clearly cover both triggers.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: HDI must return the Company's Content and data “in a commonly used, machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, HDI must delete the Content and data and certify deletion to the Company in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The clause permits assistance “for a period of up to six (6) months,” which states a maximum but does not expressly guarantee a minimum period of 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The export must occur within 30 days of the defined “Termination Date,” not expressly within 30 days after expiration as well as termination.
